method: Verified the precise fictional assembly threshold in both official papers and the existing English. Correct the imprecise Chinese source phrase, retain >50 in other languages, and do not adopt the initial >=50 suggestions. This is a focused supplemental check, not a claim to have independently reread every Japanese/Korean article.
